Component: What surprised me most was how quickly the mass and cost increase once the components required for autonomy are added.
The battery and companion computer were some of the largest contributors to mass, while the companion computer and electronics added significantly to the overall cost.
Some components were difficult to size because the final drone weight and performance requirements are not yet known.
Overall, this exercise showed that adding autonomous capabilities requires a noticeable tradeoff in weight, cost, and complexity.
